authorizedScope: Read-only bounded performance diagnosis of current reviewed S05 build; existing Owner Review engineering authority. No new product semantics or second writer.

Pause dependent catalog product edits at safe checkpoint until diagnostic is reconciled.

Compare selected/Inspector-visible and relevant widget update paths; include preview-open/closed or context count only if needed to isolate observed asymmetry.

Separate input/gesture cost, snapshot cloning, graph reconciliation/validation/constant analysis, notification and panel update counts, Inspector/widgets, Canvas DOM creation, layout/paint/frame pacing. Count repeated notifications rather than infer from static code.

Record browser/renderer/build/device/test methodology, repeat enough comparable drags to show spread, event count, frame timing and percentiles. Screenshot FPS alone is not cause attribution or performance guarantee.

Use exact reviewed archived build for baseline and a disposable byte copy if diagnostic instrumentation is needed. Establish equivalence/overhead; do not modify the live artifact or production source.

coordination.priority: Diagnosis precedes catalog-values-01 product edits. Preserve existing catalog packet unchanged for continuation; do not create another writer.

coordination.ifIdle: Dispatch this diagnosis once to original writer; do not separately dispatch catalog until result reconciled.
